Method and limits

Signals observed at one settlement are first eligible for execution at the next observation, after funding settlement. Partial fills are explicit scenario inputs. Margin breach forces a sampled-price unwind and halts entries. Margin estimates use a flat maintenance rate and closing reserve. Historical tier rules and intrainterval liquidation require additional data.

This dashboard shows the fixed October-December 2025 historical holdout. Three causal forecast families and their matched threshold strategies are evaluated in forecast_errors.csv, summary.csv and the research report. Development and validation results are separate. Better error or lower turnover does not establish alpha.

Historical snapshot, not live performance. 2025 market coverage was audited; the study was frozen before return inspection. A read-only paper collector is supplied separately. No forward track record is claimed. Contract universe covers linear USDT-settled instruments. USDT equals USD in base replay, with depeg explored separately.
